source: Owner direct chat after viewing PlayerArt-Concept02 / Candidate01
owner_direction_english_paraphrase: Variant 25 looks fresher to the owner. Develop it with modest layering and overlap of the cuirass plates.
wording_type: English paraphrase, not an exact quotation
decision: Authorize one focused concept revision, 25A, based on variant 25 (Chevron). This records directional preference and a bounded plate-construction change, not final modeling acceptance.

preserve: Fully closed helmet and concealed face.
Helmet computer rendering the interface/HUD, separate from innate powers and without restoring external command contact.
Realistic 2043 MERIDIAN setting and established story canon.
Mobile human proportions and the prior direction for more armor without a tank-like silhouette.
scope.concept_artist_configuration: Astra/max/standard, inherited from the current concept direction
scope.evaluation: Owner only; no independent expert concept evaluation or MSQ-53 expert run.

gates: Explicit owner approval of an identified final concept package, version and variant remains required before original character modeling.

Later MSQ-60 independent integrated gameplay review remains unchanged.
preservation: Preserve all prior source bytes, including Concept01 and Concept02 images, manifests, prompts, reports and approval records. Save 25A separately; do not overwrite 25.png or mutate gameplay or lobby assets.
